estilo: Lively watercolor fantasy illustration for a mobile game, thick dark ink outlines, soft paper texture, glowing magic sparkles, emerald forests, warm stone, violet magic rift glow, rich saturated colors, high quality

piezas.prompt: Tall vertical scene looking down into an enormous magical rift chasm that splits a forested fantasy kingdom. At the very top a small cozy adventurers camp on the cliff edge with tents, banners and a campfire. Mossy cliffs on both sides with huge iron chains, wooden ledges and rope bridges descending along the walls. The deeper it goes the light turns violet, glowing purple mist, floating crystal shards and faint runes at the bottom. Empty middle area for game buttons, no characters, no text
